theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (c : Rn ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (R r h β : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ R → closedBall 0 R ⊆ U → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall (0 : Rn n) R) → closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r ⊆ closedBall 0 R → 0 ≤ β → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r → V.mult x ≤ 2) → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ h) → V.weight (closedBall 0 R ∩ (V.support \ q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 R))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal β → ∫ x in closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ^ 2 ∂V.weight ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ^ n * (∫ x' in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f x' - (c + A x')‖ ^ 2) + h ^ 2 * β
